description: Returns a cryptographic proof that this offer's product row is exactly the one the merchant signed in its catalog snapshot: the signed row, its bucket hashes, the Ed25519-signed manifest, the merchant public key and step-by-step verification. Trust is anchored on the merchant domain (key fingerprint published at key_anchor), not on KaliCart. It proves the row as signed at snapshot.generated_at, not the current price or stock: the checkout is authoritative. Independent verifier: https://global.kalicart.com/ucp/tools/verify-offer-attestation.js
name: get_offer_attestation
title: Portable merchant attestation for one offer
